advHosting.title: Local hosting & support

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Every password, secret and certificate is individually encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage, with an HMAC check per entry. Even our own teams can't read your secrets: zero clear-text access.
faq.q2: Can I migrate from Bitwarden, 1Password or KeePass?
faq.a2: Yes. DencPass accepts CSV import from Chrome, Bitwarden, LastPass, KeePass and KeePassXC directly from the interface. Migration takes less than 2 minutes.
faq.q3: How does paying in FCFA work?
faq.a3: Pay by bank transfer or mobile money (Wave, Orange Money). For Enterprise editions, we issue a quote in FCFA tailored to your organization.
faq.q4: What happens if I forget my master password?
faq.a4: Click "Forgot password?" on the login page. You'll receive a reset link valid for 1 hour.
